The '''Tierfon Yellow Aces''' were a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] training [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], with a service history dating back prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==History==
The Yellow Aces, based out of the [[Tierfon Rebel Outpost]], were primarily a training squadron where most recruits were sent so that they might get some combat experience without having to face extremely difficult situations. Their missions, while technically "active," were not of the most hazardous variety. Often they were given light hit-and-fade missions typically assigned to a more experienced squad. After proving their competence, the next step up from [[Tierfon/Legends|Tierfon]] was "full active" duty on a high-security [[Star system/Legends|system]] base.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref><ref name="Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

It was the first unit of such famous [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] as [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], and [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]]. [[Nozzo Naytaan/Legends|Nozzo Naytaan]], [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]], [[Tomer Darpen/Legends|Tomer Darpen]] and [[Kissek Doran]], father of [[Kell Tainer]], were also pilots in the squadron.<ref name="GG3" /><ref name="Wraith Squadron" /><ref name="Adumar">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

During one early strike mission prior to the Battle of Yavin, the squadron targeted an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] with a strong [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] escort intending to steal a badly needed shipment of food and fuel. During the mission, Doran suffered a panic attack and tried to escape the engagement in his [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]]. In order to prevent the runaway [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] from compromising the mission and potentially leading to the complete destruction of the squadron, Janson was forced to shoot down Doran's ship, ultimately killing him. The takedown of a fellow Alliance pilot served as Janson's first official kill.<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />

Flying a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], Naytaan led the Yellow Aces on a [[Relief of Clak'dor VII|relief mission]] to [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

After the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]] and the true threat of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] was realized, Tierfon's status was boosted to "full active." But the fighter contingent on the base was significantly reduced, with other less protected bases in need of greater fighter cover. Among those in need of immediate help was the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]]. The squadron was disbanded when elements of the Yellow Aces were cobbled together along with pilots from other groups to form [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] for the assault on the Death Star.<ref name="GG3" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a squadron of volunteer pilots from [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]] led by Janson was named the [[Taanab Yellow Aces]] in honor of his old unit; that squadron fought with distinction during the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Second Battle of Borleias]].
